what: The scene-plan language (bie.scene-plan/1): what BIE's director may write. The compiler (bie/brain/video/showplan.py) refuses anything else, naming the step and the field.

plan.scenes: scenes in order; together they must cover every narration line

scene.lines: the narration line ids this scene plays over, in order
scene.cam: camera keys [{t, x, y, z, d}]: the 1920x1080 stage point at the centre, z is zoom, d seconds of travel
scene.world3d: optional 3D place under everything (a backdrop, never the thing being shown): {model, p, steps, cam3d, id (default world3d), enter} with model one of models3d; it fills the stage

time.number: seconds from the video start (only to nudge; prefer cues)

cue.word: a word of that line's subtitle (omit for the line itself)
cue.frac: 0..1 along the line when no word

person.at: instead of x, y: a 3D model's spot (see at)

item.steps: content changes [{t, p}]: from t on, a drawn thing takes these changed parameters (a vault opens, a jar fills, a world turns to night)
item.at: instead of x, y: a 3D model's spot
item.id: a name, for a 3D model that later steps put things at
item.w h: a 3D model's box on the stage (default its manifest size)

text.size: px on the 1080 stage (>= 36 after the camera)
text.at: instead of x, y: a 3D model's spot

mark.at: instead of x, y: a 3D model's spot

glow.at: instead of x, y: a 3D model's spot

map.note: the world land map (public domain); pins are your own marks and texts

hold.thing: a thing, or null to drop

give.drop_to: [x, y] to put it down instead

thing.draw: a saancha of bie/brain/video/engine/saanche.json with p = its parameters (the manifest is the law)
thing.asset: a fetched picture's name from the plan's asset list (Fluent Emoji and the asset library)
thing.mini: {draw: '__person__', look, h, pose, facing}: a small person as a thing
thing.model: {model, p}: a 3D model of bie/brain/video/engine/three/models3d.json (the manifest is the law), in an item step only (never in a group, hold, bubble or give); its steps [{t, p, d}] glide numbers over d seconds (default 0.8)
thing.y: lift when held (px above the hand)

checks: every cue word must be in its line's subtitle
every saancha parameter must fit the manifest
every text must be 36px or more on screen after the camera (CV-17)
no text may enter the subtitle strip (bottom of the stage)
texts must not cover each other for a second or more
no 2 seconds may show only text: the thing being said stays on screen
every narration line must be inside exactly one scene's lines
every 3D model parameter must fit models3d.json; cam3d keys stay in range; every at names a model of the scene and one of its spots, seen by its camera

cam3d.angle: degrees around the model (0: from the front)
cam3d.dist: camera distance from the target along the ground (0 with a height: straight down, the top view)
cam3d.spin: from t on the camera keeps turning, degrees per second

at.of: the 3D model's id (world3d for the scene's place; may be left out when the scene has one model)
at.when: the time the spot is read (default when the element appears): a moving camera moves spots, the element stays
